generated.title: Northridge 1994: The M6.7 Earthquake That Shattered Los Angeles #shorts
generated.description:
On January 17, 1994, a magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck beneath the San Fernando Valley in Los Angeles.

Freeway overpasses collapsed, apartment buildings were damaged, and thousands were injured.

The earthquake occurred on a hidden blind thrust fault — not the San Andreas Fault.

Discover how Northridge changed earthquake engineering and why dangerous faults can remain hidden beneath major cities.
